INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, CREATED_AT, LAST_MESSAGE, LAST_MESSAGE_AT -- TRADE_STATUS 는 DB DEFAULT 'NONE' ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, SYSDATE, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, r.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, r.BUYER_ID AS buyerId, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE AS lastMessage, r.TRADE_STATUS AS tradeStatus,
-- 상품 정보 p.TITLE AS productTitle, p.PRICE AS price, p.STATUS AS status,
-- 대표 이미지 (1번 이미지) (SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND ORDERS = 1 ) AS productImageUrl,
-- 각 방별 미읽은 메시지 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND m.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND m.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS unreadCount FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE r.SELLER_ID = #{userId} OR r.BUYER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MESSAGE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE ( MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT, IS_READ -- SENT_AT 은 컬럼 DEFAULT (SYSDATE) 사용 ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, ROOM_ID AS roomId, SENDER_ID AS senderId, CONTENT AS content, SENT_AT AS sentAt, IS_READ AS isRead FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY SENT_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM r ON m.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID WHERE (r.SELLER_ID = #{userId} OR r.BUYER_ID = #{userId}) AND m.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND m.IS_READ = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM r ON m.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID WHERE m.IS_READ = 'N' AND m.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND (r.SELLER_ID = #{userId} OR r.BUYER_ID = #{userId})

SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, r.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, r.BUYER_ID AS buyerId, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, r.LAST_MESSAGE AS lastMessage, r.TRADE_STATUS AS tradeStatus,
m.NAME AS opponentName, m.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS opponentProfileImagePath,
( SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND ORDERS = 1 ) AS productImageUrl FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN MOKU_USER m ON r.BUYER_ID = m.USER_ID WHERE r.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC NULLS LAST
